title: Prediction-Assisted Pricing and Admission for LLM APIs with Stochastic Token Consumption
abstract: arXiv:2609.00710v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An LLM application often sells or internally allocates several service products: a small or premium model, a short or long token cap, and possibly multiple posted prices. The operational decision is not merely which model answers a prompt. A price changes purchase probability, a token cap changes both user value and the tail of resource consumption, and accepted requests compete for shared compute and premium-model capacity. Demand and output length are initially uncertain, while an offline model may provide useful but imperfect predictions.   We formulate sequential pricing and admission with stochastic resource consumption. Each arriving request belongs to an observable segment. The platform chooses a product--price pair or makes no offer; purchase, revenue, and resource use are then random. translated_title: 基于预测辅助的随机令牌消耗LLM API定价与准入
translated_abstract: 一个LLM应用通常销售或内部分配多种服务产品：小型或高级模型、短或长的令牌上限，以及可能存在的多个公布价格。运营决策不仅仅是选择哪个模型来回答提示：价格会改变购买概率，令牌上限会同时影响用户价值和资源消耗的尾部，而被接受的请求会竞争共享的计算资源和高级模型容量。需求和输出长度最初是不确定的，而离线模型可以提供有用但不完美的预测。我们针对随机资源消耗情形制定了序贯定价与准入问题。每个到达的请求属于一个可观测的细分市场。平台选择一个产品-价格组合或不提供报价；随后购买、收入和资源使用都是随机的。离线预测器为每个细分市场-产品单元提供统一的、经过验证的误差半径。我们提出了预测裁剪UCB（PCUCB）算法，它…
tldr: 该论文提出了PCUCB（预测裁剪UCB）算法，利用经过验证的离线预测误差界，解决LLM API在令牌消耗随机不确定情况下的动态定价与请求准入决策问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PCUCB (Prediction-Clipped UCB), an algorithm that leverages validated offline prediction error bounds to solve dynamic pricing and admission decisions for LLM APIs under stochastic token consumption.
